question: True or false: more than nine in ten of the words GPT-3 was trained on were English?
answer: True: 92.6% by word count, in the figures OpenAI published. French came second, at 1.8%, and German third, at 1.5%. The model's picture of the world was drawn mostly from English pages, which is part of why early chatbots handled other languages, and the places where they are spoken, less well.
move: Ask what the sample was made of before trusting its picture of the world.
trap: False, picturing a multilingual web rather than the text actually chosen.
